scope: New experiments only. Existing PX-01 is a historical deterministic pixel probe, not a model result.

experiments.hypothesis: Required input/output and gradient paths are executable on available hardware.
experiments.success_condition: Pin code and weights; verify required interfaces and record actual budget before large runs.

experiments.hypothesis: Normative and observed events can be labeled without leakage.
experiments.success_condition: Verify permissions, norms, stable instance identities and group-separated splits; all planned counts replaced by actual manifests.

experiments.hypothesis: Independent RGB observation rejects wrong histories and reports unknown evidence.
experiments.success_condition: Proposed controlled coverage >=0.90 and false acceptance upper95 <=0.05; separately audit model-output and real-domain coverage.

experiments.hypothesis: Temporal sampling and codecs preserve relevant short-stroke evidence.
experiments.success_condition: Identify information loss before learning; restrict or modify protocol when required events become indistinguishable.

experiments.hypothesis: Comparable generators exhibit repeatable process failures beyond terminal glyph quality.
experiments.success_condition: Use fixed prompts/seeds and all-attempt denominator; establish nontrivial headroom with observable failures.

experiments.hypothesis: H1: actual visual history improves observed-event and first-error reasoning.
experiments.success_condition: History interventions change relevant judgments while irrelevant equal-area changes do not explain the effect.

experiments.hypothesis: Single-task adapters and objectives can learn the small development problem.
experiments.success_condition: Check labels, masks, gradients and reload before attributing failures to task conflict; overfit results are not generalization claims.

experiments.hypothesis: H2: correct event control can improve actual RGB execution.
experiments.success_condition: Separate planning, spatial information and execution; report privileged oracle inputs in their own table.

experiments.hypothesis: Joint CE and visual generation learning improves the minimal baseline.
experiments.success_condition: Measure both tasks and regressions; do not attribute extra supervision or longer training solely to sharing.

experiments.hypothesis: Localized event identity and targeted execution losses address the diagnosed failure mode.
experiments.success_condition: Add one mechanism at a time; verify gradient paths and information parity.

experiments.hypothesis: H3: sharing has value beyond separate models with equivalent information and supervision.
experiments.success_condition: Proposed primary gain >=5pp and CI lower>0, character accuracy noninferiority lower>=-2pp; shrink sharing claim when unmet.

experiments.hypothesis: H4: actual RGB feedback helps beyond plan feedback and equal-cost retries.
experiments.success_condition: No hidden rewriting of published history; separate diagnosis, correction choice and executed recovery.

experiments.hypothesis: H5: gains transfer to held-out characters/styles/renderers and multi-character sequences.
experiments.success_condition: Freeze protocol before test; retain all failures and report each OOD axis; REC-01 optional if recovery is claimed.

experiments.hypothesis: Event-aware compute allocation improves efficiency at fixed verified quality.
deliverables: quality-cost curves with all auxiliary calls
experiments.success_condition: Optional after core quality is established; no saving by discarding hard examples or suppressing short events.
